decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE containing the complete supplied contact-page copy, including the Founding Dealer audience and demo follow-up language; no additional state change is necessary.
The source defines the contact form's audience and follow-up process and does not change the hero visual, mobile framing, media layout, or dealership action links.
